references.text: Here the text reminds us that with God all things are possible, as when Abraham believed God's promise of a son despite his and Sarah's advanced age.
This verse reflects the idea that God can do what is impossible for humans, in connection with God's ability to save.
Similar to Jesus' words that for humans this is impossible, but for God all things are possible, in connection with the question of who can be saved.
Here it is also expressed that nothing is impossible for God, in connection with the angel's message to Mary that she will give birth to Jesus.
This verse reflects the belief that God can make the impossible possible, as shown through Abraham's faith and actions.
